body.name: Observable arm-cell compatibility set \(\mathcal V_{L,\kappa}\)
body.construction: For \(v=(v_0,v_1)\in\Delta^{2L}\times\Delta^{2L}\), set \(r_0(v)=v_{0,0^{\star}}\), \(r_d(v)=v_{0,(d,0)}+v_{0,(d,1)}\), \(c_0(v)=v_{1,0^{\star}}\), \(c_d(v)=v_{1,(d,0)}+v_{1,(d,1)}\), \(q_{0d}(v)=v_{0,(d,1)}\), \(q_{1d}(v)=v_{1,(d,1)}\), \(R_d(v)=\sum_{j=0}^{d}r_j(v)\), \(C_d(v)=\sum_{j=0}^{d}c_j(v)\), and \(\ell_d(v)=\max\{0,C_d(v)-R_{d-1}(v)\}\). Then \(\mathcal V_{L,\kappa}=\{v\in\Delta^{2L}\times\Delta^{2L}:C_d(v)\le R_d(v)\text{ for }d=0,\ldots,L-1,\ \sum_{d=1}^{L}\ell_d(v)\ge\kappa\}\). The cumulative inequalities are the observable necessary-and-sufficient compatibility conditions for an upper-triangular layer coupling; the simplex coordinates already impose \(0\le q_{0d}(v)\le r_d(v)\) and \(0\le q_{1d}(v)\le c_d(v)\).
